rounds.text: Meera Industries is currently trading at a P/E ratio of 121x [E1], which represents a significant premium over the sector benchmark of 31.49x [E6]. This valuation is increasingly detached from operational reality, as evidenced by the fact that price growth has outpaced profit growth by 97% [E55]. The company’s efficiency is also concerning, with an ROA of 2.18% compared to a sector benchmark of 8.05% [E8]. Furthermore, the momentum is shifting negatively, as evidenced by a -9% contraction in sales over the trailing twelve months [E17] and a clear deceleration in earnings growth [E67]. Conceded: the company has demonstrated long-term resilience with 17% compounded sales growth over 10 years [E14] and recent quarterly sales improvements [E65]. However, the current market capitalization of ₹ 91.0 Cr [E3] appears difficult to justify given the combination of high valuation multiples and declining recent performance.
